newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends off day's lows as Dow pares losses.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends off day's lows as Dow pares losses.

text.p: ** FTSE 100 pares losses to end 1.1 pct lower as Wall Street
recovers. Dow off 41 pts as London markets close, having
fallen by 85 pts initially after Intel profit warning.
** UK financial sector leads decline on profit-taking ahead
of Halifax flotation. Goldman goes underweight in sector.
